task.title: Change a person
task.shortdesc: Correct a name, a date or a place on a person's page.

prereq.p: Open the person first. shows how.

step.cmd: Scroll to the bottom of the page and choose .

stepresult.p: The page turns into a form, in one column on the left. With the iPad on its side, the family tree stays on the right. The form may open part of the way down, so scroll up to see the names.The family tree stays on the right.

info.p: To record another name, choose under . Choose a such as or . Then type the names. shows how to change a date.

step.cmd: Under the form, choose to keep your changes, or to leave the form as it was.

result.p: Your changes are saved to the file as you go. The page shows the new words.
result.note: The button sits below . It removes the person. Check before you choose it.
